feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 3 August 2026 10:42pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 03 August 2026 at 10:40pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic and low pressure to the west of Ireland as various fronts affect Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

East or Southeast 3 or 4, increasing 4 or 5 overnight and occasionally touching 6 for a time in the far north of the area. Veering South 3 or 4 tomorrow morning, increasing South or Southwest 4 or 5 in afternoon and evening, occasionally touching force 6 in the over central and western parts for a time in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, these dying out tomorrow morning, but areas of mist with fog patches developing for a time, these clearing in afternoon.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor in rain and mist and very poor in fog patches. Generally good later tomorrow.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 4 or 5, veering West or Southwest overnight into Wednesday and increasing 5 or 6, 6 or 7 by about midday Wednesday, possibly touching gale 8 later in the day.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming mainly moderate, moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Fair, then showers laater.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, but moderate in showers later.
